column1: # The stages a person plays today (the six of the showcase and the multiplayer playtest), and the content each runs on.
# stage <tab> name <tab> content packs <tab> features its own code switches on (optional)
# Packs are separated by commas. "pack" takes every section of the pack; "pack:ai+surfaces" takes only those sections
# (a stage assembled by hand reads one pack for combat and another for the AI). A later pack replaces a section whole.
# The last column is a debt: a switch that sits in the stage's code, where no content pack can reach it.
